title: Tupelo Honey Vacation Rental
meta_description: Tupelo Honey is a 4.00 bedroom, 3.50 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: DescriptionTupelo HoneyPompano Place Community, Inlet BeachPompano Court, Rosemary Beach, FL 32461Home Highlights:4 Bedrooms, 3.5 Bathrooms (see “Room Details” for layouts)Sleeps up to 14 guests3,056 sq. ft. with 800+ sq. ft. of outdoor living space1st Floor: Open concept living, dining, kitchen, and powder room2nd Floor: Second living area, 3 bedrooms including a Queen Guest Master Suite with private bath, a Queen bedroom, and a bunk room with 2 sets of bunk beds (sleeps 8) sharing a full hallway bath3rd Floor: Luxurious King Master Suite with sitting area, coffee bar, balcony with Gulf views, and private bath with walk-in shower, soaking tub, and double vanityTVs are internet-based (streaming/apps only; no cable)Driveway accommodates 3–4 vehicles depending on size; no overflow parkingFour adult 26" bikes included seasonally (Dec–Feb bikes not included; rentals available)Ring doorbell camera covers exterior front entry/porch areaDescription:Welcome to Tupelo Honey, a charming three-story beach house perfectly blending classic Southern style with modern elegance. With peek-a-boo Gulf views and 4 bedrooms plus 3.5 baths, it comfortably sleeps up to 14 guests. Spacious living areas on the 1st and 2nd floors make it ideal for family gatherings, while the 3rd floor King Master Suite offers a serene retreat with stunning Gulf vistas. Step outside to the fenced backyard with a grill, or enjoy the community pool just across the street. Located in Inlet Beach, bordering Rosemary Beach, fine dining, shopping, and year-round family fun are just minutes away. The sugary white sands of 30A are only a short stroll from your front porch. Tupelo Honey is your perfect coastal getaway!Community Amenities:Private community pool (steps from home; cannot be heated)Public beach access just a 2-minute walk awayBeach Access:The Inlet Beach Regional public access is 0.1 mile from the home (2–3 minute walk or 1-minute bike ride). Restrooms and showers are available, with a long, stair-free walkway to the beach. Beach setup rentals are limited; guests may bring setups from local vendors if desired.Parking:Driveway parking for 3–4 small vehicles. Garage is not available for guest use.Policies & Booking:No smokingPets not allowed (service animals only with prior notification and documentation)Rates exclude taxes and fees50% due at booking; balance due 60 days before arrival5% cancellation fee applies; initial 50% refundable if canceled >60 days before arrivalOptional travel insurance availableCheck-in: 4:00 PM CST | Check-out: 10:00 AM CSTGuests must be at least 25 years old
